scope: One bounded efficiency diagnostic for a separately source-bound, one-start refined anchored-density proposal. No posterior, convergence or scientific measurement.
density: Unchanged anchored_sampling.configuration. The actual frozen normalized Gaussian/t5 q is loaded from anchored-refined-density-proposal-v1; MH includes logq(current)-logq(candidate). All prior rejects and repeated states remain recorded. One source-bound native initialization precedes target evaluation.
limits: Finite single-chain pilot metrics are noisy, unqualified numerical diagnostics. An unseen mode may remain. Successful-native fallback counts do not count failed internal attempts; any appended frozen-surrogate CAMB failure log stops and is retained. No target/prior adjustment, clipping, annealing or proposal adaptation. All production and native-correction gates remain required.
production: Root controls any later four-chain resource allocation after independent source review and this completed pilot; the pilot does not launch production.
